note: Target register profiles injected into every batch worksheet. Files are the authoritative source; the runner has an identical minimal builtin fallback.

journal.label: 期刊/会议论文 (journal / conference paper)
journal.voice: impersonal, third person or passive voice where the field expects it
journal.hedging: keep the original hedging strength; never promote 'may' to 'does'
journal.first_person: avoid unless the source already uses 'we'
journal.notes: concise, information-dense sentences; no marketing adjectives; no undefined abbreviations

thesis.label: 学位论文 (thesis / dissertation)
thesis.hedging: keep hedging; explanatory repetition is acceptable
thesis.first_person: allowed where the source uses it
thesis.notes: longer explanatory sentences are acceptable; keep chapter-level terminology stable

grant.label: 基金申请书 (grant proposal)
grant.hedging: keep uncertainty about outcomes, do not overclaim feasibility
grant.first_person: 'we propose / we will' is normal if present in the source
grant.notes: emphasise significance and feasibility without inventing preliminary data

review_response.label: 审稿回复 (reviewer response)
review_response.hedging: do not concede more than the authors conceded in the source
review_response.notes: answer the concern first, then report the change; never invent new experiments

abstract.label: 摘要 (abstract)
abstract.hedging: keep the source's claim strength exactly
abstract.first_person: follow the field convention of the source
abstract.notes: one paragraph, no undefined abbreviations, no new numbers

unknown.label: 未指定的学术文体 (unspecified academic register)
unknown.notes: minimal edit; flag what could not be determined
